svg.title: InventarMind - Solution Architecture
svg.text: Azure Container Apps environment (inventarmind-env) - Log Analytics for console logs
LangGraph supervisor workflow (runs inside the API container)
OpenAI o3 planner when a key is set
optional LLM can only lower reliability
LLM function calling maps the PO
Python verifies exact match, then writes
Draft PO as JSON, XML or EDI 850
proposal is stored as a pending approval in PostgreSQL
ERP draft PO and vendor email only after po_approved and value < $50k
OIDC login, builds images, pushes to ACR
Azure icons: Microsoft Azure Architecture Icons. Business Central: Microsoft Dynamics 365 icons. Container Apps use the Container Apps Environments icon; agent nodes use the Bot Services icon.
